avg_returns

#Simulating Random Portfolio Weights
from datetime import datetime
np.random.seed(int(np.round(datetime.now().timestamp(),0)))
weights = np.random.lognormal(size=(N_PORTFOLIOS, n_assets))
weights /= np.sum(weights, axis=1)[:, np.newaxis]
weights

#Calculating Portfolio Metrics
portf_rtns = np.dot(weights, avg_returns)
portf_vol = []
for i in range(0, len(weights)):
    portf_vol.append(np.sqrt(np.dot(weights[i].T, np.dot(cov_mat, weights[i]))))
portf_vol = np.array(portf_vol)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import yfinance as yf

# Download stock data
selected_stocks = yf.download(["BIMAS.IS", "EKGYO.IS", "GUBRF.IS"],
                              start="2014-07-30", end="2024-07-30")["Adj Close"]

# Calculate daily returns
returns = selected_stocks.pct_change().dropna()

# Calculate IQR
iqr_bimas = np.percentile(returns['BIMAS.IS'], 75) - np.percentile(returns['BIMAS.IS'], 25)
iqr_ekgyo = np.percentile(returns['EKGYO.IS'], 75) - np.percentile(returns['EKGYO.IS'], 25)
iqr_gubrf = np.percentile(returns['GUBRF.IS'], 75) - np.percentile(returns['GUBRF.IS'], 25)

print(f"IQR for BIMAS.IS: {iqr_bimas}")
print(f"IQR for EKGYO.IS: {iqr_ekgyo}")
print(f"IQR for GUBRF.IS: {iqr_gubrf}")

# Plotting boxplots
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.boxplot([returns['BIMAS.IS'], returns['EKGYO.IS'], returns['GUBRF.IS']],
            labels=['BIMAS.IS', 'EKGYO.IS', 'GUBRF.IS'])
plt.title('Boxplot of Daily Returns for BIMAS.IS, EKGYO.IS, and GUBRF.IS')
plt.ylabel('Daily Return')
plt.show()
parametreler: günlük getiri pct_change; IQR = P75 − P25; boxplot; 2014-07-30 – 2024-07-30
not: aykırı değer tespiti hesabı tam; işlem kuralı yok

import yfinance as yf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Download stock data
selected_stocks = yf.download(["BIMAS.IS", "EKGYO.IS", "GUBRF.IS"],
                              start="2014-07-30", end="2024-07-30")["Adj Close"]

# Calculate daily returns
returns = selected_stocks.pct_change().dropna()

# Calculate volatility (standard deviation of returns)
volatility_bimas = returns['BIMAS.IS'].std()
volatility_ekgyo = returns['EKGYO.IS'].std()
volatility_gubrf = returns['GUBRF.IS'].std()

print(f"Volatility (Std Dev) for BIMAS.IS: {volatility_bimas}")
print(f"Volatility (Std Dev) for EKGYO.IS: {volatility_ekgyo}")
print(f"Volatility (Std Dev) for GUBRF.IS: {volatility_gubrf}")

# Plotting Kernel Density Plots for each stock's returns
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

sns.kdeplot(returns['BIMAS.IS'], shade=True, label=f'BIMAS.IS (Volatility: {volatility_bimas:.4f})')
sns.kdeplot(returns['EKGYO.IS'], shade=True, label=f'EKGYO.IS (Volatility: {volatility_ekgyo:.4f})')
sns.kdeplot(returns['GUBRF.IS'], shade=True, label=f'GUBRF.IS (Volatility: {volatility_gubrf:.4f})')

plt.title('Kernel Density Plot of Daily Returns')
plt.xlabel('Daily Return')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
